definitions.explanation: the involuntary expulsion of stomach contents through the mouth

examples.japanese: {嘔吐|おうと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
⟦{吐|は}き{気|け}→吐き気：05021_hakike⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{嘔吐|おうと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have symptoms of nausea and vomiting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{嘔吐|おうと}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I vomited due to food poisoning.

notes:
Composed of {嘔|おう} (vomit) + {吐|と} (spit out). A formal/medical term; not typically used in casual conversation.

REGISTER COMPARISON:
- {嘔吐|おうと}: formal/medical (used in reports, hospital settings)
- ⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧: standard ("to throw up")
- ⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧: euphemistic ("to bring up")
- ゲロ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧: crude/slang ("to puke")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {嘔吐|おうと}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to vomit
- {嘔吐|おうと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: cannot stop vomiting
- {嘔吐|おうと}⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧: vomit (the substance)
- {嘔吐|おうと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{催|もよお}す→催す：11517_moyoosu⟧: to feel the urge to vomit

RELATED SYMPTOMS:
- ⟦{吐|は}き{気|け}→吐き気：05021_hakike⟧: nausea
- {悪心|おしん}: nausea (medical term)
- ⟦{下痢|げり}→下痢：05382_geri⟧: diarrhea (often occurs together)

USAGE:
The kanji {嘔|おう} is complex and rarely handwritten. The word is more commonly seen in print and medical documents.
